name: card_case3
purpose: Case example card for a career-consulting landing page (example, not a real testimonial)
layout: A single white card with a thick yellow (#f6c90e) border and a yellow offset shadow, on a pale sky-blue (#d3e4ee) page background. From top to bottom: (1) two-line bold headline in navy (#1f3a57), the part given as 'orange' written in orange (#d2562a) with a hand-drawn wavy orange underline; (2) a wide landscape photograph: a young Japanese staff member in a store uniform smiling in a bright consumer-electronics store, with a small navy label tag at its bottom-right corner containing the caption; (3) centered banner text with a yellow marker highlight and sparkle stars on both sides; (4) a polished 3D-style bar chart panel with a white rounded background, faint light-grey horizontal gridlines and a thin baseline: on the left a short grey glossy gradient bar, on the right a tall orange (#d2562a to #f08a4b) glossy gradient bar with soft drop shadow, bar heights roughly proportional to the stated figures, each bar with a white pill label above it and its value caption below it, a thick yellow-orange curved arrow rising from the left bar to the right bar, and a navy round badge with a white border and gold ring at the right edge overlapping the chart showing the badge text on short lines with the numeric part large in yellow (#ffe98a) like a track-record medal; (5) a short paragraph in dark text with the key phrase in orange; (6) no footnote. The left bar must be visibly shorter than the right bar.

text_blocks.headline_line1: 派遣3年から家電販売へ
text_blocks.banner: 残業は月10時間以内、休みもしっかり
text_blocks.paragraph: 派遣として3年働いたあと、家電販売の仕事へ。月収は5万円アップし、残業は月10時間以内、休日もしっかり休めるようになりました。
text_blocks.note: Every number must be rendered exactly as given.

style: Japanese landing-page section graphic, flat vector UI layout combined with a natural photograph, crisp heavy Japanese gothic (bold sans-serif) lettering, high contrast, clean, professional advertising quality, mobile-first
text_rule: Render every Japanese string EXACTLY as given in text_blocks, character by character, with correct kanji/hiragana/katakana. Do not add any other text, numbers, logos or watermark. Text must be sharp and legible.
